title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that Congress should take all appropriate measures to ensure that the United States Postal Service remains an independent establishment of the Federal Government and is not subject to privatization.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
summary: This resolution expresses the sense of the House of Representatives that Congress should ensure that the U.S. Postal Service is not privatized and remains an independent establishment of the federal government.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
